name: Paani
mission:
Our mission is to provide temporary relief where we can and work toward building permanent solutions to the most complex problems that countries like Pakistan are facing. We strive to combine evidence-based initiatives with cultural competency to ensure that community members feel comfortable
and empowered in our presence.
theoryOfChange: Paani’s organizational goals center around creating sustainable, community-led solutions to the global water crisis. Our primary focus is to increase access to clean, safe drinking water in underserved regions—primarily in Pakistan—through the construction of deep water wells, solar-powered water centers, and sanitation infrastructure.We aim to:Expand Clean Water Access: Build scalable water projects that directly serve families and communities lacking reliable access to safe drinking water. This includes deep wells, solar water centers, filtration systems, and rainwater harvesting solutions.Promote Health and Hygiene: Reduce the prevalence of waterborne diseases and improve public health outcomes by integrating hygiene education and sanitation facilities into our projects.Empower Local Communities: Work alongside local partners and community leaders to ensure every project is tailored to the community’s specific needs and managed sustainably.Drive Transparency and Accountability: Maintain donor trust through rigorous monitoring, reporting, and real-time updates on project progress and impact.Foster Global Awareness: Engage youth, volunteers, and global supporters to raise awareness of the water crisis and mobilize collective action through storytelling, research, and advocacy.Support Broader Development Goals: Use water as an entry point to support education (especially for girls), gender equity, economic development, and climate resilience.Through these goals, Paani seeks not only to provide water, but to unlock the potential for healthier, more self-reliant communities and a more equitable future.

rich_narrative.summary: In FY2025, Paani managed <cite id="6">Total Revenue of $2,958,342</cite> to address the water crisis and support underserved communities in Pakistan [6]. The organization operates as a <cite id="2">zakat-eligible nonprofit</cite> providing clean water wells, orphan support, and emergency relief [2][4]. Paani maintains strong governance and holds <cite id="1">an overall score of 91.8/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> [1]. Financial figures from FY2025 show a <cite id="6">Program expense ratio of 87.8%</cite>, exceeding the sector benchmark [6]. However, revenue decreased significantly in recent filings, falling from <cite id="3">$2,547,511 in FY2023</cite> to <cite id="6">$784,162 in FY2024</cite> [3][6]. The organization tracks four outcome metrics and earned a <cite id="1">Platinum Seal of Transparency</cite> [1].
